name: NATO

flag.description: A dark blue field with a white four-pointed compass rose inside a white ring in the centre, and four white lines running out from it towards the edges.
flag.symbolism: Blue stands for the Atlantic Ocean, the circle for unity, and the compass rose for the common road to peace the members chose.

hook: NATO is a white compass rose on navy blue with four lines shooting out north, south, east and west, like a map pinned to the Atlantic.
trivia: The North Atlantic Treaty was signed in Washington, D.C. on 4 April 1949 by twelve founding countries.
Finland joined in 2023 and Sweden in 2024, bringing the alliance to 32 members.
